items.title: Gravity has stretched and copied galaxies in this picture 🤯
items.text: Gravity has stretched and copied galaxies in this picture 🤯 This cluster is so massive that it bends the light from galaxies far behind it. It’s called gravitational lensing, and sometimes it shows the same galaxy four times or more. Only 10 to 20% of galaxy clusters do that. esawebb has now spotted it twice in this one, which has never happened before.
